(Japanese: 真実 Truth) is the 35th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Hariru battles against Fraud.
Carola reveals that Fraud is actually the boss of Great Gavel who made himself younger with their technology.
Fraud reveals to Hariru that it was actually him who killed his father, not Arcades.
